headline: Earnings grow again as full-year guidance is raised
summary_short: ONEOK reported Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS of $1.53, up 14.2% y/y and 24.4% q/q, and raised full-year 2026 net income guidance to a $3.41-3.79B range with a $3.6B midpoint.
summary_long: EPS of $1.53 rose 24.4% q/q and 14.2% y/y as net income grew 13% y/y to $967M on record NGL raw feed throughput and higher refined-products and natural-gas-processing volumes, with increased optimization and marketing activity across segments also contributing. Adjusted EBITDA rose 7% y/y to $2.12B. ONEOK raised full-year 2026 guidance for net income (to $3.41-3.79B, midpoint $3.6B), adjusted EBITDA (to $8.2-8.5B, midpoint $8.35B) and diluted EPS (to a $5.68 midpoint), citing continued strong segment performance and a constructive market environment; 2026 capex guidance of $2.7-3.2B is unchanged.
